caption:
Gemini sold every coin it had 16 minutes before the US$2.5 billion Binance hack. 🤯

4:08 p.m. ET: Gemini sells all its Bitcoin and Ethereum.
4:24 p.m.: the first hacked money leaves Binance.

Did it know? No: its reason was inflation, the Fed and a tech selloff. Binance never came up. And it can't backdate anything: the race runner fills every trade at the live price at that moment.

So: GENIUS or LUCK? Comment one word. 👇
